A1_WORKER_IDENTITY.requirement: At actual start time, confirm the real OS-level worker's PID, creation time, image path and command line match exactly what was launched, using the EXISTING self-report + parent-verification handshake pattern already frozen and used in COLLECTOR_RESOURCE_SAMPLING_FIX / COLLECTOR_READINESS_REBIND (worker self-reports pid/creation_filetime/image_path via a nonce handshake; the orchestrator independently re-derives and verifies the same fields via its own OS handle before trusting it).
A1_WORKER_IDENTITY.explicitly_not: This is NOT a new Readiness run and does NOT reopen G5. No resource-sampling gate is being re-evaluated; only start-time worker identity is confirmed for THIS specific formal-start launch.

A2_STREAM_HEALTH.requirement: aggTrade message_count > 0 REQUIRED. diff_depth message_count > 0 REQUIRED. clock_observer final_state == HEALTHY AND at least 1 observation with availability == AVAILABLE and a successfully parsed source/stratum/leap_indicator REQUIRED. forceOrder may legitimately have 0 payload (liquidations are a windowed-snapshot phenomenon), but its component lifecycle must be explicitly observable in supervisor_state (not silently absent) and must never reach a silently-dead/unobserved state.

A3_EVIDENCE_WRITER_INTEGRITY.requirement: For each of the three new evidence writers introduced by COLLECTOR_DAY1_COMPLETENESS_FIX -- depth_snapshot, clock_observations, rest_telemetry -- require dropped_count == 0, backlog_at_stop == 0, and evidence_sink_failure_count == 0.

A4_EXCHANGE_TIMESTAMP_CONVERTIBILITY.requirement: The exchange timestamp on every market-stream record must be PRESENT and deterministically convertible to UTC. Binance sends epoch milliseconds; the record is NOT required to already carry a timezone-aware UTC string.

A5_SEGMENTED_CONTINUITY.requirement: diff_depth continuity is required WITHIN each valid continuity segment (i.e. between resyncs), with every segment break carrying explicit gap/resync provenance in the gap ledger. One single unbroken update_id chain across the ENTIRE file/run is NOT required and is not the correct acceptance test -- a legitimate resync mid-run is expected to appear as a provenanced break, not as a failure.

A6_CLEAN_PROCESS_EXIT.requirement: At the end of the 900-second window, the collector worker process must be stopped through the same verified-handle mechanism used in G4/G5/G6 (GetExitCodeProcess on a verified actual-worker handle after a signaled wait), and must produce a process_exit_evidence record (schema COLLECTOR_PROCESS_EXIT_EVIDENCE_V1) showing the same verified worker_pid/creation_filetime as A1 and a captured exit_code. Startup acceptance is proven against the real, identity-verified worker process for its entire run, not inferred from an unverified process or a bare wall-clock timeout.
